items.title: Remote Ischemic Conditioning Modulates Spinal Reflex Excitability in Healthy Young Adults: A Pilot Randomized Controlled Trial
items.summary: A pilot RCT involving 26 healthy young adults randomized to RIC or sham groups found that remote ischemic conditioning (RIC) paired with balance training led to a greater reduction in Hslp/Mslp ratio (p=0.02) and improved balance performance (p=0.02) compared to sham, suggesting RIC may modulate spinal reflex excitability and enhance neuroplastic adaptations.
items.curatedReason: 这项试点 RCT 提示远程缺血预处理 (RIC) 结合平衡训练可能有助于调节脊髓反射兴奋性并改善健康年轻人的平衡表现。虽然只是初步证据，但其为未来在大规模试验中探索 RIC 在神经康复领域的应用奠定了基础。
items.titleZh: 远程缺血预处理调节健康年轻成人脊髓反射兴奋性的初步随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对26名健康年轻成人的试点RCT发现，远程缺血预处理 (RIC) 结合平衡训练的组别，其 Hslp/Mslp 比率（p=0.02）降低更多，平衡表现（p=0.02）改善更显著。这提示 RIC 可能调节脊髓反射兴奋性并增强神经可塑性适应。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot RCT suggests that remote ischemic conditioning (RIC) combined with balance training may help modulate spinal reflex excitability and improve balance performance in healthy young adults. Although preliminary, it lays the groundwork for future larger trials to explore RIC's application in neurological rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 本研究为试点随机对照试验，样本量较小且仅限于健康年轻成人，结果外推需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: This was a pilot randomized controlled trial with a small sample size, limited to healthy young adults, so results should be interpreted with caution.

items.title: Identifying activities and participation domains with severe dependence using the ICF-based LIMOS-Br in chronic stroke.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study of 100 chronic stroke individuals using LIMOS-Br found that the frequency of functioning limitations does not always reflect the severity of dependence. Fine hand use (35%), complex domestic tasks (29%), and community mobility (85% prevalence; 24% severe dependence for moving around) showed high frequencies of severe dependence, suggesting a need to consider both aspects in rehabilitation planning.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究强调，卒中后功能障碍的发生频率不完全等同于依赖的严重程度。评估慢性卒中患者时，你需要同时关注 ICF 活动和参与领域的发生频率和严重程度，尤其留意精细手部使用、复杂家务活动和社区移动能力。
items.titleZh: 使用基于 ICF 的 LIMOS-Br 识别慢性卒中中重度依赖的活动与参与领域
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 100 名慢性卒中患者的横断面研究使用 LIMOS-Br，发现功能受限的频率不一定反映依赖的严重程度。研究指出精细手部使用（35%）、复杂家务（29%）和社区移动（移动85%患病率；24%重度依赖）在重度依赖中频率较高，提示康复规划需同时考虑这两个方面。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study highlights that the frequency of post-stroke functional limitations doesn't always reflect dependence severity. When assessing chronic stroke patients, you should consider both the frequency and severity of ICF activity and participation domains, particularly focusing on fine hand use, complex domestic activities, and community mobility.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面设计，无法建立因果关系，且样本量较小仅限巴西卒中患者。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional study cannot establish causality, has a small sample size, and is limited to Brazilian stroke patients.

items.title: Rehabilitation to support leisure participation following stroke: a national survey of clinical practice in Australia.
items.summary: A national Australian survey of 131 allied health clinicians (35% physiotherapists) revealed that while most refer to guidelines for stroke rehabilitation, leisure participation assessments often lack specific scales, and common interventions target underlying impairments, with limited funding and training identified as barriers.
items.curatedReason: 澳大利亚的卒中康复实践中，休闲参与的评估和干预仍缺乏标准化，这提示您在临床实践中可能需要更具体的指导和资源，以更好地支持患者重返休闲活动。
items.titleZh: 支持卒中患者休闲参与的康复：一项澳大利亚临床实践全国调查
items.summaryZh: 一项针对澳大利亚 131 名专职医疗临床医生（35% 为物理治疗师）的全国调查显示，尽管大多数人参考指南进行卒中康复，但休闲参与评估常缺乏具体量表，常见干预措施针对潜在功能障碍，且存在资金和培训不足的障碍。
items.curatedReasonEn: The assessment and intervention for leisure participation in stroke rehabilitation in Australia still lack standardization. This suggests you may need more specific guidance and resources in clinical practice to better support patients returning to leisure activities.
items.limitation: 研究依赖自我报告的在线调查，可能存在回忆偏倚。
items.limitationEn: The study relies on self-reported online surveys, which may introduce recall bias.

items.title: Evaluating ChatGPTs Responses to Chiropractic Patient Questions: A Comparative Study
items.summary: A study evaluating ChatGPT (GPT-5.2) responses to 30 chiropractic patient questions found them consistent with clinical practice guidelines, but with readability levels exceeding recommended patient education standards, and low inter-rater reliability among expert evaluators despite high mean scores.
items.curatedReason: GPT-5.2 在回答脊骨神经医学患者问题时，其内容与临床指南一致，但阅读难度较高。这提示您在考虑使用 AI 进行患者教育时，需要额外关注内容的易读性和个体化解读差异。
items.titleZh: 评估 ChatGPT 对脊骨神经医学患者问题的回答：一项比较研究
items.summaryZh: 一项评估 ChatGPT (GPT-5.2) 回答 30 个脊骨神经医学患者问题的研究发现，其回答与临床实践指南一致，但阅读难度超出推荐的患者教育标准，且尽管专家评分均值较高，但评分者间可靠性较低。
items.curatedReasonEn: GPT-5.2's responses to chiropractic patient questions are consistent with clinical guidelines but have a high readability level. This suggests that when considering AI for patient education, you need to pay extra attention to content readability and individual interpretation differences.
items.limitation: 研究只评估了ChatGPT在脊骨神经医学领域的表现，结果不一定能外推至物理治疗领域。
items.limitationEn: The study only evaluated ChatGPT's performance in chiropractic, and the results may not be generalizable to physical therapy.

items.title: What are the barriers and facilitators to engagement with physiotherapy among women experiencing adverse effects associated with menopause?
items.summary: A qualitative study of 12 women in the UK identified fatigue, cognitive issues, low self-efficacy, and negative language from healthcare professionals as barriers to physiotherapy engagement for menopause-related musculoskeletal pain, while direct inquiry about menopause, individualized treatment, and education were facilitators.
items.curatedReason: 本项定性研究强调了直接询问、个性化照护计划和健康教育对改善围绝经期女性肌骨疼痛患者理疗依从性的重要性。将其纳入你的初诊问诊表，尤其是在患者主诉疲劳或自我效能感低时。
items.titleZh: 围绝经期女性与物理治疗依从性的障碍与促进因素：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对英国 12 名女性的定性研究发现，疲劳、认知问题、低自我效能感及医护人员负面语言是影响围绝经期肌骨疼痛女性物理治疗依从性的障碍，而直接询问更年期情况、个性化治疗和健康教育是促进因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study highlights the importance of direct inquiry, individualized care plans, and health education in improving adherence to physiotherapy among perimenopausal women with MSK pain. Integrate these elements into your initial assessments, especially when patients report fatigue or low self-efficacy.
items.limitation: 研究样本量小，为单中心定性研究，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size and is a single-center qualitative study, limiting the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: [Correspondence] Beyond imaging thresholds in large-core stroke thrombectomy
items.summary: A letter to the editor supports an individual patient data meta-analysis showing improved functional outcomes and reduced mortality with endovascular thrombectomy for large-core ischemic stroke, challenging the paradigm of futility for reperfusion therapy in such cases.
items.curatedReason: 这封读者来信肯定了针对大核心缺血性卒中患者的血管内取栓（EVT）疗效，提示大面积梗死并非绝对禁忌。这支持你拓宽对卒中后康复预后的预期，并与神经内科医生讨论早期EVT的潜力，即使患者存在较大的梗死灶。
items.titleZh: 致编辑：大核心卒中血栓切除术的影像学阈值之外
items.summaryZh: 一封致编辑信件支持一项个体患者数据 Meta 分析，该分析显示血管内取栓可改善大核心缺血性卒中患者的功能结局并降低死亡率，挑战了此类患者再灌注治疗无效的旧观念。
items.curatedReasonEn: This letter to the editor affirms the efficacy of endovascular thrombectomy (EVT) for large-core ischemic stroke, suggesting that extensive infarction is not an absolute contraindication. This supports broadening your expectations for post-stroke rehabilitation outcomes and discussing the potential for early EVT with neurologists, even in patients with larger infarcts.

items.title: Delivering a high-dose walking booster program after stroke: a multimethod study of therapists' beliefs and experiences nested within a randomized trial.
items.summary: A multimethod study explored intervention therapists' beliefs and experiences delivering a high-dose walking booster program (HiWalk) to stroke survivors more than 6 months post-stroke, identifying facilitators like training and team support, and barriers such as beliefs about survivor capability and resource limitations.
items.curatedReason: 本研究揭示了治疗师实施卒中后高强度步行训练项目（HiWalk）时的经验和障碍，这些发现是优化密集康复方案落地实施的关键。
items.titleZh: 卒中后高剂量步行强化训练项目的实施：一项嵌套在随机试验中的多方法研究，探讨治疗师的信念与经验
items.summaryZh: 一项多方法研究探讨了在卒中后超过6个月的幸存者中实施高剂量步行强化项目（HiWalk）的干预治疗师的信念与经验，发现培训和团队支持是促进因素，而对患者能力的信念和资源限制是障碍。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study explores therapists' experiences delivering a high-dose walking program post-stroke, identifying facilitators and barriers. Understanding these factors is key for optimizing implementation of intensive rehabilitation protocols.
items.limitation: 研究涉及治疗师数量少（n=6），且嵌套于 II 期试验中，可能限制了普适性。
items.limitationEn: The study involved a small number of therapists (n=6) and was nested within a Phase II trial, which may limit generalizability.

items.title: Early postoperative functional exercise adherence and its association with 3-month hip functional recovery among older adults after femoral neck fracture surgery: a prospective observational study.
items.summary: A prospective observational study of 230 older adults after femoral neck fracture surgery found moderate early postoperative functional exercise adherence before discharge, negatively correlated with kinesiophobia and pain, and positively with self-efficacy and social support. Higher adherence was positively associated with 3-month hip functional recovery (Harris Hip Score).
items.curatedReason: 这项前瞻性观察研究发现，股骨颈骨折术后早期功能锻炼依从性与3个月时的髋关节功能恢复（Harris Hip Score）相关，提示心理、社会和连续性护理因素对依从性和预后至关重要。
items.titleZh: 股骨颈骨折术后早期术后功能性运动依从性及其与3个月髋关节功能恢复的相关性：一项前瞻性观察研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对230名股骨颈骨折术后老年患者的前瞻性观察研究发现，出院前早期术后功能性运动依从性中等，与运动恐惧和疼痛呈负相关，与康复自我效能和社会支持呈正相关。较高的依从性与3个月的髋关节功能恢复（Harris髋关节评分）显著相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This prospective observational study links early postoperative functional exercise adherence after hip fracture surgery to 3-month functional recovery. The findings highlight the importance of psychological, social, and continuity-of-care factors in improving adherence and outcomes.
items.limitation: 观察性设计无法确立依从性与功能恢复之间的因果关系。
items.limitationEn: The observational design does not establish causality between adherence and functional recovery.

items.title: Effects of extracorporeal shockwave therapy on pain intensity and functional disability in chronic low back pain: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 9 RCTs (N unspecified) found that radial extracorporeal shockwave therapy (rESWT) significantly reduced pain (SMD = -0.72) in chronic low back pain, but functional disability improvement (MD = -6.12) did not reach clinical significance. Most outcomes were evaluated immediately post-intervention.
items.curatedReason: 关于体外冲击波疗法（ESWT）治疗慢性腰痛的系统综述提示，ESWT，特别是径向冲击波，对短期疼痛有效，但功能改善临床意义不大。这意味着你在考虑 ESWT 时应将其作为辅助手段，而非替代主动训练。
items.titleZh: 体外冲击波疗法对慢性腰痛患者疼痛强度和功能障碍的影响：一项系统综述和荟萃分析。
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 9 项 RCT 的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，径向体外冲击波疗法（rESWT）显著减轻了慢性腰痛患者的疼痛（SMD = -0.72），但功能障碍的改善（MD = -6.12）未达到临床意义；多数结果仅在干预后即刻评估。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review on extracorporeal shockwave therapy (ESWT) for chronic low back pain indicates that ESWT, particularly radial ESWT, is effective for short-term pain but offers limited clinically meaningful functional improvement. This suggests you should consider ESWT as an adjunct, not a replacement for active rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 研究随访时间短，且纳入研究间存在显著异质性，限制了建议的强度。
items.limitationEn: The studies had short follow-up periods, and substantial heterogeneity across included trials limits the strength of recommendations.

items.title: Physical activity guidelines' impact on cognition in multiple sclerosis: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized clinical trials.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 12 RCTs (N=462) found that meeting physical activity guidelines for multiple sclerosis (PAG-MS) significantly improved processing speed (SMD = 0.29), visuospatial memory (SMD = 0.47), and verbal memory (SMD = 0.75) in individuals with MS.
items.curatedReason: 运动处方在 MS 康复中的核心地位再次得到强化。这项系统综述和荟萃分析有力地证实，鼓励患者达到多发性硬化症（MS）体育活动指南，可显著改善他们的处理速度、视觉空间记忆和语言记忆。
items.titleZh: 体育活动指南对多发性硬化症患者认知能力的影响：一项随机临床试验的系统综述和荟萃分析。
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 12 项 RCT（N=462）的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，达到多发性硬化症体育活动指南可显著改善患者的处理速度（SMD = 0.29）、视觉空间记忆（SMD = 0.47）和言语记忆（SMD = 0.75）。
items.curatedReasonEn: The central role of exercise prescription in MS rehabilitation is further solidified. This systematic review and meta-analysis strongly confirms that encouraging patients to meet physical activity guidelines for multiple sclerosis (MS) significantly improves their processing speed, visuospatial memory, and verbal memory.
items.limitation: 研究基于有限数量的研究，且存在较高的偏倚风险，需要更多高质量的随机对照试验。
items.limitationEn: The findings are based on a limited number of studies with a high risk of bias, and more RCTs are needed.

items.title: Early supervised physiotherapy session-completion adherence and outcomes after acute lateral ankle sprain in professional athletes: concurrent indirect associations through kinesiophobia
items.summary: A single-center retrospective cohort study (N=118 professional athletes) found that higher adherence to early supervised physiotherapy (per 10-percentage-point increase) was associated with a higher rate of achieving return to sport (HR = 1.27), lower odds of ankle instability (OR = 0.70), and lower residual pain (B = -0.36) after acute lateral ankle sprain. Kinesiophobia was identified as an important concurrent psychological correlate.
items.curatedReason: 对于职业运动员的急性外侧踝关节扭伤，早期监督物理治疗的依从性至关重要。这项观察性研究提示，依从性每提高 10%，重返运动率将提高，踝关节不稳的几率降低，残余疼痛也能减轻。此外，运动恐惧症（kinesiophobia）是不可忽视的心理因素，评估时务必纳入考虑。
items.titleZh: 职业运动员急性外侧踝关节扭伤后早期监督物理治疗疗程完成依从性与结局：通过运动恐惧症的同期间接关联。
items.summaryZh: 一项单中心回顾性队列研究（N=118 名职业运动员）发现，早期监督物理治疗依从性越高（每增加 10 个百分点），急性外侧踝关节扭伤后重返运动率越高（HR = 1.27），踝关节不稳几率越低（OR = 0.70），残余疼痛越少（B = -0.36）。运动恐惧症被认为是重要的同期心理相关因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: Adherence to early supervised physiotherapy is crucial for professional athletes with acute lateral ankle sprain. This observational study suggests that for every 10-percentage-point increase in adherence, the return-to-sport rate increases, the odds of ankle instability decrease, and residual pain is reduced. Additionally, kinesiophobia is an important psychological factor that must be considered during assessment.
items.limitation: 这是一项单中心回顾性队列研究，无法推断因果关系，且结果可能受到未测量混杂因素的影响。
items.limitationEn: This is a single-center retrospective cohort study, which cannot infer causality and its results may be influenced by unmeasured confounding factors.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Significant others' perspectives on formal supports at 3- and 12-months post-discharge from specialist rehabilitation units following acquired brain injury and spinal cord injury.
items.summary: A qualitative study explored significant others' perspectives on formal support 3 and 12 months post-discharge from specialist rehabilitation after acquired brain injury (ABI) and spinal cord injury (SCI), identifying communication, understanding individual needs, and gaps in formal support as key themes.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究强调了在脑损伤和脊髓损伤患者出院后，家庭成员在支持系统中的重要作用以及他们所面临的挑战。这提示你在康复计划中应更主动地纳入家属，并提供明确的指导和心理社会支持。
items.titleZh: 从获得性脑损伤和脊髓损伤专科康复病房出院后 3 个月和 12 个月，重要他人在正式支持方面的视角。
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究探讨了获得性脑损伤和脊髓损伤患者出院后 3 个月和 12 个月时，重要他人在正式支持方面的看法，发现了沟通、理解个体需求和正式支持缺口等关键主题。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study highlights the critical role and challenges faced by family members in supporting individuals with acquired brain injury and spinal cord injury post-discharge. This suggests you should more actively involve significant others in rehabilitation planning and provide clear guidance and psychosocial support.
items.limitation: 该研究为定性研究，样本量小，且仅限于澳大利亚昆士兰地区，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study with a small sample size, limited to Queensland, Australia, which limits the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Process evaluation of daily electrical stimulation to prevent recurring pressure ulcers in individuals with spinal cord injury: the SCI PREVOLT trial.
items.summary: A mixed-methods process evaluation of the SCI PREVOLT trial assessed electrical stimulation (ES) implementation for pressure ulcer prevention in spinal cord injury. Recruitment via rehabilitation centers was effective, but usability, organizational barriers, and limited evidence hindered long-term adherence and adoption.
items.curatedReason: 这项过程评估揭示了电刺激预防脊髓损伤压疮在家庭环境和康复护理中实施的障碍与促进因素。这提示你，如果考虑应用电刺激，需要关注其易用性、明确的角色分工和强有力的支持，以提高依从性和维持率。
items.titleZh: 脊髓损伤患者日常电刺激预防压疮复发的流程评估：SCI PREVOLT 试验。
items.summaryZh: SCI PREVOLT 试验的一项混合方法流程评估，评估了脊髓损伤患者电刺激（ES）预防压疮的实施情况。通过康复中心招募有效，但易用性、组织障碍和有限的证据阻碍了长期依从和应用。
items.curatedReasonEn: This process evaluation reveals facilitators and barriers to implementing electrical stimulation for pressure ulcer prevention in spinal cord injury patients within home and rehabilitation settings. This suggests that if you consider applying electrical stimulation, you need to focus on usability, clear role delineation, and strong support to improve adherence and maintenance.
items.limitation: 研究的参与者数量有限，且为单一中心的研究，可能限制了结果的普遍适用性。
items.limitationEn: The study involved a limited number of participants and was conducted at a single center, which may limit the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Effects of Single-Session High-Definition Transcranial Alternating Current Stimulation (HD-tACS) Combined with Robot-Assisted Hand Exercises on Corticospinal Excitability in Chronic Stroke.
items.summary: A preliminary randomized crossover study (N=12 healthy, N=7 stroke) found that a single session of high-definition transcranial alternating current stimulation (HD-tACS) combined with robot-assisted hand exercises significantly increased flexor digitorum superficialis (FDS) MEP amplitudes in healthy individuals (15.3%) and showed a similar trend in stroke patients (~22.3%), suggesting enhanced corticospinal excitability.
items.curatedReason: 这项初步研究表明，将高清晰度经颅交流电刺激（HD-tACS）与机器人辅助手部运动相结合，可能在一单次疗程后增强皮质脊髓束（CST）兴奋性。这为卒中后康复中结合非侵入性脑刺激技术提供了潜在方向，但还需更大规模的研究来验证。
items.titleZh: 单次高清晰度经颅交流电刺激（HD-tACS）结合机器人辅助手部运动对慢性卒中患者皮质脊髓兴奋性的影响。
items.summaryZh: 一项初步随机交叉研究（12 名健康人，7 名卒中患者）发现，单次高清晰度经颅交流电刺激（HD-tACS）结合机器人辅助手部运动显著增加了健康个体指浅屈肌（FDS）运动诱发电位（MEP）幅值（15.3%），并在卒中患者中显示出类似趋势（约 22.3%），提示皮质脊髓兴奋性增强。
items.curatedReasonEn: This preliminary study suggests that combining single-session high-definition transcranial alternating current stimulation (HD-tACS) with robot-assisted hand exercises may enhance corticospinal tract (CST) excitability. This offers a potential direction for integrating non-invasive brain stimulation in post-stroke rehabilitation, but larger studies are needed for confirmation.
items.limitation: 这是一项初步研究，样本量小，且结果需要更大规模的研究来确认其统计显著性。
items.limitationEn: This is a preliminary study with a small sample size, and the findings require confirmation with larger studies for statistical significance.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Acceptability, Safety and Feasibility of a Sedentary Behaviour Intervention (REACH-SCI) in Individuals with Spinal Cord Injury: A Mixed-Methods Study
items.summary: A pre-post feasibility study (N=18 paraplegic wheelchair-users) found that an 8-week sedentary behavior intervention (REACH-SCI) was acceptable, safe, and feasible. It also demonstrated preliminary efficacy in improving sedentary behavior, physical activity, cardiovascular disease biomarkers, and psychosocial outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 这项预可行性研究表明，针对截瘫患者的久坐行为干预（REACH-SCI）是可接受、安全且可行的，并初步显示出改善久坐行为和心血管风险指标的潜力。这提示你可以关注这类综合性行为改变干预方案，但其长期疗效还需进一步验证。
items.titleZh: 脊髓损伤患者久坐行为干预（REACH-SCI）的可接受性、安全性和可行性：一项混合方法研究。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 18 名截瘫轮椅使用者进行的预可行性研究发现，为期 8 周的久坐行为干预（REACH-SCI）是可接受、安全且可行的。该干预还初步显示出改善久坐行为、体力活动、心血管疾病生物标志物和心理社会结局的疗效。
items.curatedReasonEn: This preliminary feasibility study suggests that the sedentary behavior intervention (REACH-SCI) for individuals with paraplegia is acceptable, safe, and feasible, showing preliminary efficacy in improving sedentary behavior and cardiovascular risk biomarkers. This indicates you can pay attention to such comprehensive behavioral change interventions, though their long-term effectiveness requires further validation.
items.limitation: 这是一项预可行性研究，样本量小，且为单中心研究，需要大型确证性试验来评估其真正效果和安全性。
items.limitationEn: This is a pre-post feasibility study with a small sample size and single-center design, requiring a definitive trial to evaluate its true effectiveness and safety.

items.title: Effects of integrating blood flow restriction (BFR) into sport-specific on-field training on athletic performance and physiological adaptations in team-sport athletes: a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 6 trials (N=102) on integrating blood flow restriction (BFR) into sport-specific on-field training found that BFR may improve relative mean power during 30-second cycling (MD = −0.50 W/kg), but its effect on lower-limb 1RM and other primary outcomes is very uncertain, with low to very low certainty of evidence.
items.curatedReason: 在运动专项场上训练中整合血流限制（BFR）的证据非常不确定，目前不应常规推荐。这项系统综述和荟萃分析提示 BFR 可能略微改善 30 秒骑行中的相对平均功率，但对于下肢 1RM 和其他关键结果，几乎没有可靠的益处证据。
items.titleZh: 将血流限制（BFR）整合到专项运动场上训练中对团队运动运动员运动表现和生理适应的影响：一项系统综述和荟萃分析。
items.summaryZh: 一项对 6 项试验（N=102）进行的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，将血流限制（BFR）整合到专项运动训练中可能改善 30 秒循环的相对平均功率（MD = −0.50 W/kg），但对下肢 1RM 和其他主要结果的影响非常不确定，证据确定性为低至非常低。
items.curatedReasonEn: Evidence for integrating blood flow restriction (BFR) into sport-specific on-field training is highly uncertain and should not be routinely recommended. This systematic review and meta-analysis suggests BFR might slightly improve relative mean power during 30-second cycling, but there is little reliable evidence of benefit for lower-limb 1RM and other primary outcomes.
items.limitation: 纳入研究数量少（6 项），异质性高，且证据确定性为低至非常低，限制了结论的可靠性。
items.limitationEn: The review included a small number of studies (6 trials), high heterogeneity, and very low certainty of evidence, limiting the reliability of the conclusions.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Smart Home Technology for Dementia Care: Supporting Aging in Place
items.summary: This review describes smart home technologies for dementia care, highlighting devices that can support safety and independence for people living with dementia at home, and serving as support systems for caregivers and healthcare professionals. It also explores potential benefits and limitations.
items.curatedReason: 虽然这篇综述不直接涉及物理治疗干预，但它提示了未来痴呆症患者居家环境可能遇到的技术辅助。作为治疗师，你应当了解这些技术如何影响患者的居家安全、独立性及照护者的负担，进而完善你的康复计划和居家指导。
items.titleZh: 用于痴呆症照护的智能家居技术：支持居家养老。
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述描述了用于痴呆症照护的智能家居技术，强调了能支持痴呆症患者居家安全和独立生活的设备，并作为照护者和医疗专业人员的支持系统。文章还探讨了潜在的益处和局限性。
items.curatedReasonEn: While not directly addressing physical therapy interventions, this review suggests potential technology assistance in future home environments for dementia patients. As a therapist, you should understand how these technologies impact patient safety, independence, and caregiver burden to refine your rehabilitation plans and home guidance.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Effects of treadmill exercise with and without vertical traction on gait, pain, disability, trunk proprioception, and depression in patients with chronic mechanical low back pain: A randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial found that treadmill exercise with vertical traction and partial body weight support (VT+TE) yielded greater improvements in gait, disability, and trunk repositioning compared to treadmill exercise alone (TE) or core stabilization in patients with chronic mechanical low back pain.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 表明，对于慢性机械性腰痛患者，跑步机锻炼结合垂直牵引和部分体重支持 (VT+TE) 在改善步态、残疾和躯干再定位方面优于单纯跑步机锻炼或核心稳定训练。这提示 VT+TE 可能是一种更有效多模式方法。
items.titleZh: 跑步机运动联合或不联合垂直牵引对慢性机械性腰痛患者步态、疼痛、残疾、躯干本体感觉和抑郁的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.titleEn: Effects of treadmill exercise with and without vertical traction on gait, pain, disability, trunk proprioception, and depression in patients with chronic mechanical low back pain: A randomized controlled trial.
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验发现，对于慢性机械性腰痛患者，跑步机运动联合垂直牵引和部分体重支撑（VT+TE）相比单独跑步机运动（TE）或核心稳定性训练，在改善步态、残疾和躯干重定位方面效果更佳。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT demonstrates that combining treadmill exercise with vertical traction and partial body weight support offers superior improvements in gait, disability, and trunk repositioning compared to treadmill exercise alone or core stabilization for chronic mechanical low back pain, suggesting a potentially more effective multimodal approach.
items.limitation: 样本量小（每组n=15），且无法区分垂直卸载和悬吊支撑的作用。
items.limitationEn: Small sample size (n=15 per group) and inability to distinguish effects of vertical unloading from harness support.

items.title: Long-Term Clinical Outcomes and Factors Associated With Response in Older Adults With Massive Irreparable Rotator Cuff Tears: A Four-Year Prospective Cohort Study.
items.summary: A 4-year prospective cohort study found that the majority of older adults with massive irreparable rotator cuff tears responded well to nonoperative treatment, with significant improvements in shoulder function and pain persisting long-term. Longer symptom duration, smoking, and diabetes were associated with worse outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 这项为期四年的前瞻性队列研究提供了有力证据，表明老年人不可修复的巨大肩袖撕裂通过标准化非手术治疗可获得显著且持久的功能改善。同时，更长的症状持续时间、吸烟和糖尿病与较差的预后相关，指导我们关注这些可改变的风险因素。
items.titleZh: 老年大块不可修复性肩袖撕裂患者的长期临床结局及相关反应因素：一项为期四年的前瞻性队列研究
items.titleEn: Long-Term Clinical Outcomes and Factors Associated With Response in Older Adults With Massive Irreparable Rotator Cuff Tears: A Four-Year Prospective Cohort Study.
items.summaryZh: 一项为期 4 年的前瞻性队列研究发现，大多数患有大块不可修复性肩袖撕裂的老年患者对非手术治疗反应良好，肩部功能和疼痛的显著改善可持续至长期。症状持续时间长、吸烟和糖尿病与较差的结局相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This prospective cohort study provides strong evidence that older adults with massive irreparable rotator cuff tears show substantial and sustained functional improvements with a standardized nonoperative management program for up to 4 years. It also identifies symptom duration, smoking, and diabetes as factors associated with less favorable trajectories, guiding clinical focus on modifiable risk factors.
items.limitation: 单一三级医疗机构环境和特定患者群体（年龄≥60岁，非创伤性MIRCTs）。
items.limitationEn: Single tertiary health care hospital setting and specific patient population (age ≥60, atraumatic MIRCTs).

items.title: Efficacy of Sensory Electrical Stimulation Versus Alternating Electromyography-Guided Electrical Stimulation on Functional Recovery of the Hand in Chronic Stroke: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial found that both sensory electrical stimulation (SES) and alternating EMG-guided electrical stimulation (Alt-EMG), when added to conventional physical therapy, significantly improved upper-limb motor function in chronic stroke patients, with no significant difference between the two stimulation methods.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 提供了高级别的证据，证明无论是感觉电刺激 (SES) 还是交替 EMG 引导电刺激 (Alt-EMG)，在结合常规物理治疗时，都能显著改善慢性卒中患者的上肢运动功能，且两种刺激方式之间无显著差异。这支持我们将这些模式整合到康复计划中，以促进功能恢复。
items.titleZh: 感觉性电刺激与交替肌电图引导电刺激对慢性卒中患者手部功能恢复的疗效比较：一项随机对照试验
items.titleEn: Efficacy of Sensory Electrical Stimulation Versus Alternating Electromyography-Guided Electrical Stimulation on Functional Recovery of the Hand in Chronic Stroke: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验发现，感觉性电刺激（SES）和交替肌电图引导电刺激（Alt-EMG）与常规物理治疗结合使用，均能显著改善慢性卒中患者的上肢运动功能，且两种刺激方法之间无显著差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT provides high-level evidence that both sensory electrical stimulation (SES) and alternating EMG-guided electrical stimulation (Alt-EMG), when combined with conventional physical therapy, significantly improve upper-limb motor function in chronic stroke patients, with no significant difference between the two stimulation types. This supports the integration of these modalities for enhanced functional recovery.
items.limitation: 该研究未区分SES和Alt-EMG对主要结局的影响，也未探讨潜在的长期效应。
items.limitationEn: The study did not differentiate between SES and Alt-EMG for the primary outcome, and did not explore potential long-term effects.

items.title: Barriers and Facilitators Influencing Physiotherapists' Adherence to Clinical Practice Guidelines and Return to Sport Criteria after Anterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstruction: A Qualitative Study in Austria.
items.summary: A qualitative study identified limited usability of ACLR guidelines, patient expectations, professional attitudes, and interprofessional misalignment as key barriers to CPG and RTS criteria adherence among Austrian physiotherapists.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究揭示了奥地利物理治疗师在依从 ACLR CPG 和 RTS 标准时面临的关键障碍，如指南可用性差、患者期望和专业态度。了解这些因素对优化康复结果和确保临床实践一致性至关重要。
items.titleZh: 影响前交叉韧带重建术后物理治疗师遵循临床实践指南和重返运动标准的障碍与促进因素：奥地利一项定性研究
items.titleEn: Barriers and Facilitators Influencing Physiotherapists' Adherence to Clinical Practice Guidelines and Return to Sport Criteria after Anterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstruction: A Qualitative Study in Austria.
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究发现，奥地利物理治疗师在遵循前交叉韧带重建术后临床实践指南和重返运动标准方面，面临的主要障碍包括指南可用性有限、患者期望、职业态度和多专业协调不畅。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study reveals key barriers (e.g., guideline usability, patient expectations, professional attitudes) and facilitators (e.g., structured guidelines, professional development, institutional support) to physiotherapists' adherence to ACLR CPGs and RTS criteria. Understanding these factors is crucial for optimizing rehabilitation outcomes and consistent clinical practice.
items.limitation: 定性研究，样本量小（来自奥地利一个国家的9名物理治疗师）。
items.limitationEn: Qualitative study with a small sample size of 9 physiotherapists from a single country (Austria).
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Development and validation of a prediction model for subsequent fractures after hip fracture surgery in older adults: a retrospective cohort study.
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study developed and validated a prediction model using six predictors (including age, hip function, neurodegenerative disease, eye disease, living alone, and exercise) to estimate the risk of subsequent fractures within 2 years after hip fracture surgery in older adults.
items.curatedReason: 这项回顾性队列研究开发并验证了一个预测髋部骨折术后再次骨折的模型，识别出年龄、髋关节功能和合并症等关键预测因子。模型有助于风险分层，但其对不同患者群体的适用性尚需进一步考量。
items.titleZh: 老年人髋部骨折手术后继发性骨折预测模型的开发与验证：一项回顾性队列研究
items.titleEn: Development and validation of a prediction model for subsequent fractures after hip fracture surgery in older adults: a retrospective cohort study.
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性队列研究开发并验证了一个预测模型，该模型使用六个预测因子（包括年龄、髋部功能、神经退行性疾病、眼部疾病、独居以及运动）来估计老年人髋部骨折术后两年内发生继发性骨折的风险。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study developed and validated a prediction model for subsequent fractures after hip surgery, identifying key predictors like age, hip function, and comorbidities. While useful for risk stratification, it's a retrospective observational study, and its applicability to diverse patient populations needs further consideration.
items.limitation: 回顾性队列研究设计，预测模型对研究环境外人群的普适性尚需验证。
items.limitationEn: Retrospective cohort study design, and the prediction model's generalizability to populations outside the study setting requires validation.

items.title: Efficacy and safety of mitapivat in patients with sickle cell disease (RISE UP): a phase 3, double-blind, global, randomised, placebo-controlled trial
items.summary: Mitapivat, an oral pyruvate kinase activator, is presented as a potential disease-modifying treatment for sickle cell disease, offering a novel mechanism to reduce hemolytic anemia and potentially serving as an effective and convenient option.
items.curatedReason: 本文介绍了 mitapivat 这种口服丙酮酸激酶激活剂，作为镰状细胞病的潜在疾病修饰疗法，它通过新机制改善溶血性贫血。然而，这只是一篇简短的概述，我们还需要更多关于 RISE UP 试验中疗效和安全性方面的详细数据。
items.titleZh: 匹伐他司坦治疗镰状细胞病患者的疗效与安全性（RISE UP）：一项III期、双盲、全球、随机、安慰剂对照试验
items.titleEn: Efficacy and safety of mitapivat in patients with sickle cell disease (RISE UP): a phase 3, double-blind, global, randomised, placebo-controlled trial
items.summaryZh: 匹伐他司坦（Mitapivat），一种口服丙酮酸激酶激活剂，因其改善溶血性贫血的新颖机制，有潜力成为镰状细胞病一种有效的、便利的疾病修饰性治疗方法。
items.curatedReasonEn: This article introduces mitapivat, an oral pyruvate kinase activator, as a promising disease-modifying treatment for sickle cell disease due to its novel mechanism for ameliorating hemolytic anemia. However, it is a brief summary and further details on efficacy and safety from the RISE UP trial are needed.
items.limitation: 这是对一项试验的简要总结，而非完整的科研论文。
items.limitationEn: This is a brief summary of a trial, not the full research paper.

items.title: Preoperative factors associated with quadriceps strength 1 year after total knee arthroplasty: a prospective longitudinal study.
items.summary: In 39 older adults with uncomplicated recovery after TKA, preoperative normalized quadriceps strength (B = 0.72, p < 0.001) and limb symmetry index (LSI) (B = -0.17, p = 0.013) were significantly associated with quadriceps strength 1 year post-TKA, suggesting higher preoperative strength and LSI predict better 1-year outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究提示，膝关节置换术后 1 年股四头肌力量和肢体对称性的恢复，与术前力量及对称性密切相关。这强化了术前康复的重要性，但需要更多大型研究来确认。
items.titleZh: 全膝关节置换术后 1 年股四头肌力量相关术前因素的预测性纵向研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 39 名老年膝关节置换患者的纵向研究发现，术前标准化股四头肌力量（B = 0.72, p < 0.001）和肢体对称指数（LSI）（B = -0.17, p = 0.013）与术后 1 年股四头肌力量显著相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that 1-year quadriceps strength and limb symmetry post-TKA are strongly associated with preoperative strength and symmetry. This reinforces the importance of preoperative rehabilitation, though larger studies are needed for confirmation.
items.limitation: 这是一项探索性研究，样本量小（39 人），且仅限于膝关节置换术后无并发症的老年患者，外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This exploratory study has a small sample size (n=39) and is limited to older adults with uncomplicated recovery after TKA, limiting generalizability.

items.title: Do treatment parameters of dry needling influence its effect on pain? A systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 71 comparisons found no dose-response relationship between dry needling parameters (sessions, muscles, local twitch responses) and neck pain effectiveness (QM = 0.26, p = 0.968 to QM = 3.17, p = 0.205) due to high heterogeneity and incomplete reporting.
items.curatedReason: 干针治疗颈痛的剂量-反应关系尚未明确，此系统综述提示我们，在制定治疗方案时，切勿过度执着于具体的疗程次数、治疗肌肉数量或局部抽搐反应，因为目前的证据无法支持这些参数与疗效的强关联。你需要保持灵活，结合患者个体情况调整方案，而非盲目遵循经验性“剂量”。
items.titleZh: 干针治疗参数是否影响其对疼痛的疗效？一项系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 71 项比较的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，干针治疗参数（疗程、肌肉、局部抽搐反应）与颈痛疗效之间无剂量-反应关系（QM = 0.26, p = 0.968 至 QM = 3.17, p = 0.205），这可能与高度异质性和报告不完整有关。
items.curatedReasonEn: The dose-response relationship for dry needling in neck pain remains unclear. This systematic review suggests we should not rigidly adhere to specific parameters like number of sessions, muscles treated, or local twitch responses when designing treatment plans, as current evidence doesn't strongly link these to efficacy. You need to remain flexible, adapting plans to individual patient needs rather than blindly following empirical "dosages."
items.limitation: 由于研究间异质性高、报告不完整且存在偏倚风险，该荟萃分析结果应谨慎解读，尤其关于颈痛的剂量-反应关系。
items.limitationEn: Due to high heterogeneity, incomplete reporting, and high risk of bias, the meta-analysis results, particularly concerning the dose-response relationship for neck pain, should be interpreted cautiously.
items.journal: The Journal of manual & manipulative therapy

items.title: Trends in Australia's physiotherapy workforce: changes and future implications.
items.summary: Analysis of Australia's physiotherapy workforce (2013-2023) showed a 70.5% increase to 35,889 physiotherapists, but 81.0% practiced in metropolitan areas in 2023, indicating an ongoing maldistribution, with males less likely and Indigenous physiotherapists more likely to work in regional/remote areas.
items.curatedReason: 澳大利亚物理治疗师数量在过去十年间增长了 70.5%，但乡村和偏远地区的人员短缺问题仍未解决，81.0% 的治疗师集中在大都市。如果你在规划康复医疗资源，要警惕这种城市虹吸效应，并思考如何通过政策吸引更多专业人员下沉到基层，比如此研究发现原住民治疗师更可能在这些地区工作。
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚物理治疗师劳动力趋势：变化与未来影响
items.summaryZh: 对澳大利亚物理治疗师劳动力（2013-2023）的分析显示，总人数增长了 70.5% 达到 35,889 人，但 2023 年仍有 81.0% 在都市区执业，表明持续分布不均，男性在区域/偏远地区执业的可能性较低，而原住民物理治疗师则较高。
items.curatedReasonEn: Australia's physiotherapy workforce grew by 70.5% in the last decade, yet maldistribution in rural and remote areas persists, with 81.0% of therapists concentrated in metropolitan areas. If you're planning rehabilitation resources, be wary of this urban pull and consider how policies can attract more professionals to underserved regions, as this study observed Indigenous physiotherapists were more likely to work in these areas.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性观察研究，分析了澳大利亚国家健康劳动力数据集，主要描述了劳动力趋势和分布，但无法建立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This retrospective observational study analyzed Australia's National Health Workforce Dataset, primarily describing workforce trends and distribution, but cannot establish causality.

items.title: Effect of bimodal signal biofeedback on the supraglottic swallowing maneuver in patients with post-stroke dysphagia: A randomised controlled trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=30) found bimodal signal biofeedback-assisted supraglottic swallowing maneuver significantly improved FOIS scores (p < 0.001) and reduced PAS scores ≥ 6 (p = 0.026) in post-stroke dysphagia patients compared to conventional therapy after 2 weeks and at 1-month follow-up.
items.curatedReason: 对于卒中后吞咽困难患者，你可以考虑引入双模态信号生物反馈辅助声门上吞咽训练。这项小型 RCT（n=30）表明，相比传统疗法，这种技术能在 2 周和 1 个月时显著改善患者的吞咽功能（FOIS评分提升，PAS评分≥6减少）。这是一项有前景的辅助治疗手段，但其长期疗效和普适性仍需更多大型研究证实。
items.titleZh: 双模态信号生物反馈对卒中后吞咽困难患者声门上吞咽动作的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=30）发现，双模态信号生物反馈辅助声门上吞咽动作能显著改善卒中后吞咽困难患者的 FOIS 评分（p < 0.001）并降低 PAS 评分 ≥ 6（p = 0.026），效果在干预后 2 周及 1 个月随访时均优于常规治疗。
items.curatedReasonEn: For post-stroke dysphagia patients, you might consider incorporating bimodal signal biofeedback-assisted supraglottic swallowing maneuvers. This small RCT (n=30) suggests that, compared to conventional therapy, this technique significantly improves swallowing function (increased FOIS scores, reduced PAS scores ≥ 6) at 2 weeks and 1-month follow-up. It's a promising adjunct, but its long-term efficacy and generalizability still require larger studies.
items.limitation: 这是一项单中心随机对照试验，样本量相对较小（30 名患者），且随访时间较短（1 个月），长期效果和多中心可重复性仍需进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center randomized controlled trial with a relatively small sample size (30 patients) and short follow-up (1 month), thus long-term effects and multi-center reproducibility require further validation.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Implementation, feasibility and optimization of a web- and mobile-supported semi-automated shoulder rehabilitation system (WMSSR): a prospective consecutive interventional cohort study.
items.summary: A prospective interventional cohort study (n=129) found a web- and mobile-supported semi-automated shoulder rehabilitation system (WMSSR) was feasible, reducing total clinical deficit score by ≈89% (95% CI 12.83-14.75; d₍z₎ = 2.513; p < 0.001) in patients with non-traumatic shoulder pain.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究显示，网络和移动支持的半自动化肩关节康复系统在常规临床实践中可行，且与显著的临床改善相关。这提示了数字化工具在提高康复效率和标准化方面的潜力。
items.titleZh: 网络和移动支持的半自动化肩关节康复系统 (WMSSR) 的实施、可行性与优化：一项前瞻性连续干预队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性队列研究（n=129）发现，网络和移动支持的半自动化肩关节康复系统可行，并使非创伤性肩痛患者的总临床缺陷评分降低约 89%（95% CI 12.83-14.75; d₍z₎ = 2.513; p < 0.001）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study demonstrates that a web- and mobile-supported semi-automated shoulder rehabilitation system is feasible in routine clinical practice and associated with substantial clinical improvement. This suggests the potential of digital tools to enhance rehabilitation efficiency and standardization.
items.limitation: 这是一项单中心、前瞻性描述性纵向干预研究，无随机化或对照组，研究结果的因果关系和普遍适用性需进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center, prospective descriptive longitudinal interventional study without randomization or a control group, limiting the establishment of causality and generalizability.

items.title: Empowering safer mobility behaviour for fall prevention in people with Parkinson's disease: A qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study with clinicians and researchers identified empowerment as a central theme for safer mobility behavior in Parkinson's disease fall prevention, necessitating contextual, individual, and collaborative approaches to balance safety with meaningful task engagement.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究强调，对于帕金森病患者的跌倒预防，应采取赋能、个体化和协同的方法，以平衡安全与有意义的活动参与。这为临床 PT 提供了更全面的干预框架。
items.titleZh: 赋能帕金森病患者更安全的移动行为以预防跌倒：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对临床医生和研究人员的定性研究发现，赋能是帕金森病跌倒预防中更安全移动行为的核心主题，需要采用情境化、个体化和协同方法来平衡安全与有意义的任务参与。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study emphasizes an empowering, individualized, and collaborative approach to fall prevention in people with Parkinson's disease, balancing safety with meaningful activity engagement. This offers a more comprehensive intervention framework for clinical PTs.
items.limitation: 这项定性研究基于临床医生和研究人员的视角，其发现提供了概念性框架，但仍需量化研究来验证所提出方法的有效性。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study, based on clinicians' and researchers' perspectives, provides a conceptual framework but requires quantitative research to validate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

items.title: A Machine Learning Model With Temporal Validation for Predicting Walking Ability in Nontraumatic Spinal Cord Injury.
items.summary: A machine learning model, GBDT-based, achieved an AUC of 0.91 and accuracy of 0.90 in internal testing (n=148) and 0.81 accuracy in temporal external validation (n=37) for predicting walking ability in non-traumatic spinal cord injury patients, with total lower limb muscle strength and age as key predictors.
items.curatedReason: 这项初步研究开发了一个机器学习模型，可以根据早期入院指标预测非创伤性脊髓损伤患者的步行能力。虽然仍在早期阶段，但这为未来精准康复规划提供了潜力。
items.titleZh: 基于时间验证的机器学习模型预测非创伤性脊髓损伤患者的步行能力
items.summaryZh: 一个基于 GBDT 的机器学习模型在内部测试（n=148）中达到 0.91 的 AUC 和 0.90 的准确率，在时间外部验证（n=37）中达到 0.81 的准确率，用于预测非创伤性脊髓损伤患者的步行能力，其中下肢总肌肉力量和年龄是关键预测因子。
items.curatedReasonEn: This preliminary study developed a machine learning model to predict walking ability in non-traumatic spinal cord injury patients based on early admission indicators. While still early, this offers potential for future precise rehabilitation planning.
items.limitation: 该模型是在单中心开发和验证的，样本量相对较小（148 例开发，37 例外部验证），因此在推广到临床应用前需要更大规模、多中心队列的确认。
items.limitationEn: The model was developed and validated at a single center with a relatively small sample size (148 for development, 37 for external validation), thus requiring confirmation in larger, multicenter cohorts before clinical application.

items.title: Quality of Movement Assessment after ACL Reconstruction in Youth: A Clinical Framework to Guide Rehabilitation and Return-to-Sport Decision-Making.
items.summary: A framework is presented to guide rehabilitation and return-to-sport decisions after ACL reconstruction in youth athletes by incorporating quality of movement assessments beyond quantitative outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 在青少年运动员 ACL 重建术后的康复和复训决策中，不要只看定量指标。这份框架提示你，结合运动质量评估能让你更全面地判断运动员是否真正准备好重返赛场，值得在实践中借鉴。
items.titleZh: 青少年ACL重建后运动质量评估：指导康复与重返运动决策的临床框架
items.summaryZh: 本文提出了一个框架，通过纳入运动质量评估（超越定量指标）来指导青少年运动员ACL重建后的康复和重返运动决策。
items.curatedReasonEn: For youth athletes post-ACL reconstruction, solely relying on quantitative metrics for return-to-sport is insufficient. This framework suggests incorporating quality of movement assessments, offering a more holistic view of readiness and a valuable guide for your clinical practice.
items.limitation: 本临床框架基于专家意见和现有文献（证据等级5），需进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: This is a clinical framework based on expert opinion and existing literature (Level of Evidence 5), requiring further validation.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Force Plate Based Assessment of Maximal and Rapid Isometric Shoulder Strength During the Return-to-Sport Process After Pectoralis Major Repair in a World-Class Female Wrestler: A Case Report.
items.summary: A world-class female wrestler's pectoralis major repair recovery was monitored using force plate assessment (NPF and NF200), revealing angle-dependent strength deficits and delayed rapid force production recovery.
items.curatedReason: 世界级运动员胸大肌修复的案例，提示我们力板评估在追踪高水平运动表现恢复中的价值。仅依赖传统力量测试可能不足以发现角度依赖性不足和快速发力恢复的延迟，您应考虑引入更精细的评估手段。
items.titleZh: 世界级女摔跤手胸大肌修复后重返运动过程中的最大与快速等长肩部力量的平台测量评估：病例报告
items.summaryZh: 一名世界级女摔跤手胸大肌修复后的康复过程通过测力平台评估（NPF 和 NF200）进行监测，揭示了角度依赖的力量缺陷和快速力量输出恢复滞后。
items.curatedReasonEn: This case report details the use of force plate analysis to track strength recovery after pectoralis major repair in a high-level athlete, highlighting the potential utility of such assessments.
items.limitation: 本研究为世界级运动员的单一病例报告，限制了其对更广泛人群的普适性。
items.limitationEn: This is a single case report of a world-class athlete, limiting generalizability to the broader population.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Sensorimotor and Molecular Mechanisms of Non-Contact ACL Injury: An Integrative Hypothesis.
items.summary: An integrative hypothesis links feed-forward hamstring tension and titin stiffening to pre-contact landing strategies and eccentric strength training as key for non-contact ACL injury prevention.
items.curatedReason: 这份临床评论提出了非接触性 ACL 损伤的新假设，将感觉运动和分子层面因素结合起来，强调了股后肌群的预张力和肌联蛋白硬度在着地策略中的作用。这为您在制定 ACL 预防方案时，应更重视离心力量训练和生物力学细节提供了新思路。
items.titleZh: 非接触性ACL损伤的传感器运动和分子机制：一个整合假说
items.summaryZh: 一项整合假说将肌肉牵张前肌张力和titin的僵化与接触前着陆策略及离心力量训练联系起来，是预防非接触性ACL损伤的关键。
items.curatedReasonEn: This clinical commentary proposes an integrative hypothesis for non-contact ACL injury mechanisms, linking sensorimotor and molecular factors to guide prevention strategies.
items.limitation: 本研究为旨在指导未来研究的理论模型（证据等级5），并非基于直接临床试验数据。
items.limitationEn: This is a theoretical model intended to guide future research (Level of Evidence 5), not based on direct clinical trial data.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Letter to Editor: Effects of a Teleexercise Movement-to-Music Intervention on Health Outcomes in Individuals With Mobility Disabilities: A Randomized Controlled Trial
items.summary: A letter to the editor identifies statistical reporting issues in a teleexercise movement-to-music intervention study for mobility disabilities, potentially affecting the interpretation of treatment effects.
items.curatedReason: 这封读者来信指出了一个针对行动障碍者的远程运动-音乐干预研究在统计报告上的问题，这可能影响您对治疗效果的解读。在采纳该研究结论时，您应审慎评估其统计效力。
items.titleZh: 致编辑的信：一项针对运动障碍者的远程运动音乐干预对健康结果的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一封致编辑的信指出了针对运动障碍者的远程运动音乐干预研究中的统计报告问题，可能影响治疗效果的解释。
items.curatedReasonEn: This letter to the editor raises statistical reporting issues with a teleexercise study, suggesting potential impact on interpretation of results for individuals with mobility disabilities.
items.limitation: 本研究为致编辑信，旨在评论一项已发表的研究，并非原始研究。
items.limitationEn: This is a letter to the editor commenting on a published study, not original research.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Comparison of short-foot and toe-curl exercises on movement control during single-leg landing after ACL reconstruction: An exploratory randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: In an exploratory RCT (N=38 ACLR patients), short-foot exercise (SFE) lowered hip adduction excursion during single-leg landing at 6 weeks compared to toe-curl exercise (TCE), with a between-group difference of -6.30° (95% CI, -9.19 to -3.41; ES, -1.41), and this improvement was maintained at 12 weeks.
items.curatedReason: 这项探索性 RCT 提示，对于 ACLR 术后患者，短足运动可能比足趾卷曲运动能更早地改善单腿着陆时的额状面运动控制。考虑将其作为你早期康复方案的潜在优化方向。
items.titleZh: ACL重建术后单腿着陆运动控制中短足运动与足趾卷曲运动的比较：一项探索性随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项探索性随机对照试验（N=38 名 ACLR 患者）显示，与足趾卷曲运动相比，短足运动在单腿着陆时能更早降低髋关节内收偏移，6 周时组间差异为 -6.30° (95% CI, -9.19 to -3.41; ES, -1.41)，且该改善在 12 周时依然维持。
items.curatedReasonEn: This exploratory RCT suggests that short-foot exercises may facilitate earlier improvement in frontal-plane movement control during single-leg landing in ACLR patients, compared to toe-curl exercises. Consider this as a potential optimization for your early rehabilitation protocols.
items.limitation: 这是一项探索性研究，样本量较小（38 人），结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This is an exploratory study with a small sample size (38 participants), limiting the generalizability of its findings.
items.journal: Physical therapy in sport : official journal of the Association of Chartered Physiotherapists in Sports Medicine

items.title: Sexual harassment experienced by nurses in a spinal cord injury rehabilitation center.
items.summary: A cross-sectional survey (N=48 nurses) in a SCI rehabilitation center found that 87.5% reported experiencing patient-perpetrated sexual harassment within the past 12 months, with verbal harassment (87.5%) being more prevalent and severe than nonverbal (62.5%) and physical (50.0%) forms.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究揭示了脊髓损伤康复中心护士遭受患者性骚扰的高发生率，特别是言语形式。这提示你在康复环境中需要更关注工作场所安全，并为团队提供相关培训和支持。
items.titleZh: 脊髓损伤康复中心护士遭受性骚扰的经历
items.summaryZh: 一项针对脊髓损伤康复中心护士（N=48）的横断面调查发现，87.5% 的护士在过去 12 个月内曾遭受患者性骚扰，其中言语骚扰（87.5%）比非言语（62.5%）和身体（50.0%）形式更普遍且严重。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study reveals a high prevalence of patient-perpetrated sexual harassment against nurses in SCI rehabilitation centers, especially verbal forms. This highlights the need for increased focus on workplace safety in rehabilitation settings and providing relevant training and support for your team.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面调查，仅能提供患病率而非因果关系，且可能存在回忆偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional survey, which can only provide prevalence rates rather than causality, and may be subject to recall bias.

items.title: "It's important, but at a cost…": healthcare professionals and people with aphasia describe what influences use of a novel, digital communication aid.
items.summary: This study, based on interviews with 10 healthcare professionals (HCPs) and 3 people with aphasia (PWA), explored influences on the use of a novel digital communication aid. HCPs recognized the app's value but faced constraints from clinical, communicative, and emotional demands, alongside a lack of healthcare system support.
items.curatedReason: 本研究揭示了失语症数字辅助沟通工具在医院应用中面临的挑战。即使有明确的临床价值，其采用仍受限于医疗系统的工作量和支持不足。这提示你在引入新技术时，需考虑机构层面的文化和系统性支持。
items.titleZh: “这很重要，但有代价……”：医护人员和失语症患者描述了影响新型数字沟通辅助工具使用的因素
items.summaryZh: 这项研究基于对 10 名医疗专业人员（HCPs）和 3 名失语症患者（PWA）的访谈，探讨了影响新型数字沟通辅助工具使用的因素。HCPs 认可该应用程序的价值，但其使用受到临床、沟通和情感需求以及医疗系统支持不足的制约。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study highlights challenges in implementing digital communication aids for aphasia in hospitals. Despite clear clinical value, adoption is constrained by healthcare system workload and lack of support. This suggests that when introducing new technologies, you need to consider organizational culture and systemic support.
items.limitation: 本研究的样本量较小（10 名医疗专业人员和 3 名失语症患者），可能存在观察者偏倚和召集偏倚，且主要依赖定性访谈。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size (10 HCPs and 3 PWAs), which may introduce observer and recruitment bias, and primarily relies on qualitative interviews.

items.title: Psychometric Evaluation of the Parental Education in Physiotherapy Scale: A Brief Measure of Family-Centered Educational Practices in Pediatric Physiotherapy.
items.summary: The Parental Education in Physiotherapy (PEP) scale, an 8-item, 3-factor measure (Collaboration, Capacity-Building, and Reflection), demonstrated excellent psychometric properties (CFI = 1.000, RMSEA = 0.011, SRMR = 0.031) in a cross-sectional study of 310 Spanish physiotherapists, confirming its utility for assessing family-centered educational practices in pediatric physiotherapy.
items.curatedReason: PEP 量表提供了一个评估儿科物理治疗中以家庭为中心的教育实践的有效工具。如果你在儿科领域执业，可以使用此量表来反思和改进你向家庭提供教育和支持的方式。
items.titleZh: 儿科物理治疗中家长教育量表的心理测量学评估：一项以家庭为中心的教育实践的简要测量工具
items.summaryZh: 儿科物理治疗中家长教育（PEP）量表，一个包含 8 个条目、3 个因子（协作、能力建设和反思）的测量工具，在针对 310 名西班牙物理治疗师的横断面研究中，表现出优秀的心理测量学特性（CFI = 1.000, RMSEA = 0.011, SRMR = 0.031），证实其在评估儿科物理治疗中以家庭为中心的教育实践方面的效用。
items.curatedReasonEn: The PEP scale offers a valid tool for evaluating family-centered educational practices in pediatric physiotherapy. If you practice in pediatrics, you can use this scale to reflect on and improve how you provide education and support to families.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面设计，且主要基于西班牙的物理治疗师样本，外推性可能受限。
items.limitationEn: This study has a cross-sectional design and is primarily based on a sample of physiotherapists in Spain, which may limit its generalizability.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Do Subsamples Provide Reproducibility Estimates Comparable to the Full Sample in Trial-Based Ultrasound Muscle Measurements?
items.summary: This study investigates whether subsamples can provide reproducibility estimates comparable to the full sample in trial-based ultrasound muscle measurements.
items.curatedReason: 在超声肌肉测量中，小样本可能无法提供与全样本相当的重现性估计。如果你正在设计相关研究或评估超声测量结果，需警惕仅依赖小样本可能导致的数据可靠性问题。
items.titleZh: 在基于试验的超声肌肉测量中，子样本是否能提供与全样本相当的重现性估计？
items.summaryZh: 本研究探讨了在基于试验的超声肌肉测量中，子样本是否能提供与全样本相当的重现性估计。
items.curatedReasonEn: For ultrasound muscle measurements, subsamples might not yield reproducibility estimates comparable to a full sample. When designing your research or evaluating ultrasound measurements, be wary that relying solely on small samples could compromise data reliability.
items.journal: Measurement in Physical Education and Exercise Science

items.title: A mobile-based multimodal monitoring system with clinician feedback for home rehabilitation after stroke: a randomized clinical trial
items.summary: In a single-center RCT with 110 stroke survivors, a 6-week multimodal monitoring intervention significantly improved 6-minute walk distance by 23.15m (95% CI 6.70 to 39.60; p=0.006) and balance compared to standard care, with high participant satisfaction but mean adherence of 60%.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 证明了卒中后居家康复中，结合多模态监测和临床医生反馈能显著改善患者的步行耐力。在制定卒中居家康复方案时，应考虑引入类似的数字监测与反馈机制。
items.titleZh: 卒中后居家康复中结合临床医生反馈的移动多模态监测系统：一项随机临床试验
items.summaryZh: 在一项包含 110 名卒中幸存者的单中心随机对照试验中，为期 6 周的多模态监测干预，相较于标准护理，显著改善了 6 分钟步行距离 23.15 米（95% CI 6.70 至 39.60；p=0.006）和平衡能力，患者满意度高，但平均依从性为 60%。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT demonstrates that integrating multimodal monitoring with clinician feedback significantly improves walking endurance in post-stroke home rehabilitation. When designing home rehabilitation protocols for stroke, consider incorporating similar digital monitoring and feedback mechanisms.
items.limitation: 尽管有显著改善，但多模态监测的长期依从性有限并随时间下降，提示未来实施需关注可用性和可持续性。
items.limitationEn: Despite significant improvements, long-term adherence to multimodal monitoring was limited and declined over time, suggesting future implementations need to focus on usability and sustainability.

items.title: Construct validity and intrasession intra-rater reliability of the stair and step tests in individuals with multiple sclerosis.
items.summary: This study involving 100 MS patients found the Stair and Step Tests have excellent test-retest reliability (ICC 0.997 and 0.955, respectively) and strong construct validity, making them practical for monitoring mobility.
items.curatedReason: 阶梯和踏步测试在 MS 患者中显示出优异的信效度，是临床实践中监测移动能力的快速且低疲劳的有效工具。
items.titleZh: 多发性硬化症患者阶梯测试和踏步测试的构建效度与会内评估者内信度
items.summaryZh: 这项纳入 100 名多发性硬化症（MS）患者的研究发现，阶梯测试和踏步测试具有出色的重测信度（ICC 分别为 0.997 和 0.955）和强大的构建效度，使其成为监测移动能力的实用工具。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Stair and Step Tests demonstrated excellent reliability and validity in MS patients, making them quick, low-fatigue, and effective tools for monitoring mobility in clinical practice.
items.limitation: 研究样本量相对较小，且为单中心研究，可能影响结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The relatively small sample size and single-center nature of the study may limit the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Hybrid versus in-clinic rehabilitation for non-traumatic shoulder pain within a standardized digital care pathway: a prospective longitudinal observational study
items.summary: This observational study of 164 patients with non-traumatic shoulder pain found no clear difference in time to clinical discharge (time ratio 0.92, 95% CI 0.79–1.07) between hybrid and in-clinic rehabilitation, with similar improvements in deficit score, pain, and Constant–Murley scores.
items.curatedReason: 对于非创伤性肩痛患者，混合康复模式（每周一次门诊+两次居家）与纯门诊康复在临床出院时间和功能结果上没有显著差异。这为提高患者依从性和可及性提供了支持。
items.titleZh: 标准化数字护理路径下非创伤性肩痛的混合式与门诊康复比较：一项前瞻性纵向观察研究
items.summaryZh: 这项对 164 名非创伤性肩痛患者进行的观察研究发现，混合式康复与纯门诊康复在临床出院时间上无显著差异（时间比 0.92，95% CI 0.79–1.07），且在缺陷评分、疼痛和 Constant–Murley 评分方面改善相似。
items.curatedReasonEn: For non-traumatic shoulder pain, a hybrid rehabilitation model (one in-clinic + two home sessions weekly) showed no significant difference in clinical discharge time or functional outcomes compared to purely in-clinic rehabilitation. This supports improving patient adherence and accessibility.
items.limitation: 这是一项观察性研究，存在非随机分配和潜在混杂因素，不能确定因果等效性或非劣效性。
items.limitationEn: This is an observational study with non-random allocation and potential confounding factors, so it cannot establish causal equivalence or non-inferiority.

items.title: Pelvic Floor Yoga for Women with Overactive Bladder-Wet: A Subgroup Analysis of a Multisite Randomized Trial
items.summary: In 140 women with OAB-wet, a subgroup analysis of a multisite RCT found pelvic floor yoga reduced UUI frequency by 1.9 episodes/day and UDI-6 scores by 10.3 points, with a between-group difference of -7.1 (95% CI -12.2, -1.8) favoring yoga for UDI-6.
items.curatedReason: 对膀胱过度活动症（湿型）女性，盆底瑜伽能比一般体能锻炼带来更大的尿困扰和日间排尿频率改善，提示其作为社区康复手段的潜力。
items.titleZh: 盆底瑜伽在湿型膀胱过度活动症女性中的疗效：一项多中心随机试验的亚组分析
items.summaryZh: 一项多中心随机对照试验的亚组分析显示，在 140 名湿型膀胱过度活动症女性中，盆底瑜伽将尿急尿失禁（UUI）频率降低了 1.9 次/天，UDI-6 评分降低了 10.3 分，其中 UDI-6 的组间差异为 -7.1（95% CI -12.2, -1.8），有利于瑜伽。
items.curatedReasonEn: For women with OAB-wet, pelvic floor yoga led to greater reductions in urinary distress and daytime voiding frequency compared to general physical conditioning, indicating its potential as a community-based rehabilitation approach.
items.limitation: 这是一项预设的亚组分析，并非独立的 RCT，需要更大型的研究来确认盆底瑜伽的独立疗效。
items.limitationEn: This is a prespecified subgroup analysis, not an independent RCT, and larger studies are needed to confirm the independent efficacy of pelvic floor yoga.

items.title:
Impact of age and frailty on the effect of a multimodal individualized long-term intervention after stroke: the last-long trial
							| Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine
items.summary: In an RCT with 301 stroke survivors, a multimodal intervention showed no overall functional benefit. For participants ≥80 years, favorable outcomes were less likely with intervention vs. control (23.4% vs 57.0%, p=0.004). Age, but not frailty, modified the intervention effect on mRS and Trail Making Test B in younger participants.
items.curatedReason: 这项 LAST-long 试验表明，多模态卒中干预对 80 岁以上老年卒中患者效果较差，甚至可能不利。这提示你在制定老年卒中康复方案时需特别考虑年龄因素，避免一概而论。
items.titleZh: 年龄和衰弱对卒中后多模式个体化长期干预效果的影响：LAST-long 试验
items.summaryZh: 一项对 301 名卒中幸存者进行的随机对照试验显示，多模态干预并未带来整体功能益处。对于 80 岁及以上参与者，干预组获得良好结局的可能性低于对照组（23.4% vs 57.0%，p=0.004）。年龄（而非衰弱）改变了干预对 mRS 和 Trail Making Test B 的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: The LAST-long trial indicates that multimodal stroke interventions may be less effective, and potentially even detrimental, for stroke patients aged 80 and older. This suggests that you must specifically consider age when developing rehabilitation plans for older stroke patients, avoiding a one-size-fits-all approach.
items.limitation: 该研究是在挪威进行，结果可能不完全适用于其他医疗系统和文化背景的患者。
items.limitationEn: The study was conducted in Norway, and its findings may not be fully generalizable to patients in other healthcare systems and cultural contexts.

items.title: Elastic band resistance training improves physical function, gait, cardiac indices, and corticomuscular coherence in older women at risk of sarcopenia: a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: In an RCT of 40 older women at risk of sarcopenia, 12 weeks of elastic band resistance training significantly improved muscle strength and physical function (p < 0.05), reduced Ishii score (p < 0.01), increased stride length, reduced double-support time, and improved cardiac morphology and corticomuscular coherence.
items.curatedReason: 针对有肌少症风险的老年女性，弹性带抗阻训练能显著改善身体功能、步态、心脏指标和皮层肌肉相干性，提示其作为预防和干预肌少症的有效手段。
items.titleZh: 弹性带抗阻训练改善有肌少症风险老年女性的身体功能、步态、心脏指标和皮层肌肉相干性：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 在一项针对 40 名有肌少症风险老年女性的随机对照试验中，12 周的弹性带抗阻训练显著改善了肌肉力量和身体功能（p < 0.05），降低了 Ishii 评分（p < 0.01），增加了步幅，减少了双支撑时间，并改善了心脏形态和皮层肌肉相干性。
items.curatedReasonEn: For older women at risk of sarcopenia, elastic band resistance training significantly improved physical function, gait, cardiac indices, and corticomuscular coherence, suggesting its effectiveness in sarcopenia prevention and intervention.
items.limitation: 研究样本量相对较小（40 名老年女性），且仅针对有肌少症风险的女性，结果推广到其他人群需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The study's relatively small sample size (40 older women) and specific focus on women at risk of sarcopenia mean results should be generalized to other populations with caution.

items.title: Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency - Have your say: Exploring the development of common professional capabilities for all regulated health professions
items.summary: AHPRA is seeking public consultation on its draft National Scheme Professional Capabilities Framework, including pilot common professional capabilities for responding to family, domestic, and sexual violence (FDSV) and safely using digital health, with feedback open until December 18, 2026.
items.curatedReason: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管机构 (AHPRA) 正在就所有受监管健康专业的通用专业能力框架征求公众意见。你的反馈将直接影响包括物理治疗师在内的所有从业者的教育和执业标准，特别是在应对家庭暴力和安全使用数字健康技术方面。
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管机构：征集意见——探讨所有受监管健康专业的通用专业能力发展
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管机构（AHPRA）正在就其国家计划专业能力框架草案征求公众意见，其中包括应对家庭、家庭和性暴力（FDSV）以及安全使用数字健康的通用专业能力试点，意见征集截止日期为 2026 年 18 日。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA) is seeking public feedback on its draft National Scheme Professional Capabilities Framework for all regulated health professions. Your input will directly influence education and practice standards for all practitioners, including physical therapists, particularly concerning responding to family violence and safely using digital health technologies.

items.title: Anatomical Variations and Morphometry of the Pudendal Nerve: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 29 studies found the pudendal nerve most commonly presents as a single trunk (61.27%, 95% CI 48.02–73.74%), with a mean cadaveric diameter of 3.73 mm and length of 56.08 mm.
items.curatedReason: 这项荟萃分析强调了阴部神经解剖变异性的重要性，其数据能提升你在进行盆底区域手术或麻醉时的精确度和安全性。
items.titleZh: 阴部神经的解剖变异与形态测量：系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 29 项研究的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，阴部神经最常表现为单干（61.27%，95% CI 48.02–73.74%），尸体研究中平均直径为 3.73 毫米，平均长度为 56.08 毫米。
items.curatedReasonEn: This meta-analysis highlights the significant anatomical variability of the pudendal nerve, providing data to enhance precision and safety during pelvic surgeries or anesthesia.
items.limitation: 研究纳入了多种解剖研究，但没有评估不同研究方法的异质性对结果的影响。
items.limitationEn: The study included various anatomical studies but did not assess the impact of heterogeneity in research methods on the results.

items.title: From simulation to stimulation: a predictive synergy-based control strategy for functional electrical stimulation cycling in a person with spinal cord injury
items.summary: This study developed and validated a simulation-derived, synergy-based control strategy for FES cycling in one SCI patient. While empirical bang-bang (BB) protocol showed higher power and cadence, the simulation-derived control enabled unassisted FES cycling with more symmetrical balance and demonstrated methodological advantages for safe, reproducible baselines.
items.curatedReason: 这项初步研究验证了预测性协同控制策略在脊髓损伤患者功能性电刺激（FES）自行车训练中的可行性。这为 FES 控制的个性化和安全性提供了新的思路，但目前尚不如经验性策略。
items.titleZh: 从模拟到刺激：基于预测协同控制策略在脊髓损伤患者功能性电刺激自行车中的应用
items.summaryZh: 这项研究开发并验证了一种基于模拟的协同控制策略，用于脊髓损伤患者的功能性电刺激（FES）自行车训练。尽管经验性 bang-bang 方案在功率和踏频上表现更优，但模拟衍生的控制信号实现了无辅助 FES 自行车骑行，具有更对称的平衡，并展示了在安全、可重复基线方面的方法学优势。
items.curatedReasonEn: This preliminary study validates the feasibility of a predictive synergy-based control strategy for functional electrical stimulation (FES) cycling in individuals with spinal cord injury. While not yet outperforming empirical strategies, it offers new avenues for personalized and safer FES control.
items.limitation: 研究仅限于一名脊髓损伤患者的实验验证，其结果的普遍适用性非常有限。
items.limitationEn: The experimental validation was limited to one individual with spinal cord injury, which severely limits the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: PTJ Author Interview: Severe Spinal Stenosis and Exercise-Based Rehabilitation
items.summary: An APTA podcast interview discusses a study finding that the severity of lumbar spinal stenosis (mild, moderate, or severe) does not impact responsiveness to exercise-based rehabilitation, challenging conventional clinical decision-making regarding surgical referrals.
items.curatedReason: 这项 PTJ 作者访谈强调，腰椎管狭窄的严重程度不影响患者对运动康复的响应。这意味着无论影像学结果如何，运动疗法都应被视为一线治疗，并挑战了将严重病例优先转诊至手术的传统观念。
items.titleZh: PTJ 作者访谈：重度脊柱管狭窄与运动康复
items.summaryZh: 美国物理治疗协会（APTA）播客访谈讨论了一项研究，发现腰椎管狭窄（轻度、中度或重度）的严重程度不影响对运动康复的响应，这挑战了传统临床决策中关于手术转诊的观念。
items.curatedReasonEn: This PTJ author interview highlights that the severity of lumbar spinal stenosis does not affect patient responsiveness to exercise-based rehabilitation. This means exercise therapy should be considered a first-line treatment regardless of imaging results, challenging the traditional view of prioritizing severe cases for surgery.

items.title: Patient Voices in a Digital Space: Thematic Analysis of YouTube Comments on Pelvic Floor Content
items.summary: A thematic analysis of 14.7K YouTube comments on pelvic floor content found three major themes: desire for community, healthcare experiences (including mistrust), and desire for knowledge, highlighting the platform's role for PFD patients.
items.curatedReason: YouTube 是盆底功能障碍患者寻求社区支持和知识的重要平台，尤其对于面临医疗障碍的人群。你可以考虑将此平台纳入患者教育和支持策略。
items.titleZh: 数字空间中的患者声音：盆底内容 YouTube 评论的主题分析
items.summaryZh: 对盆底内容相关 YouTube 评论的 1.47 万条评论进行主题分析，发现三个主要主题：对社区的渴望、医疗保健经验（包括不信任）以及对知识的渴望，突显了该平台对盆底功能障碍患者的作用。
items.curatedReasonEn: YouTube is a vital platform for individuals with pelvic floor disorders seeking community support and knowledge, especially for those facing healthcare barriers. Consider integrating this platform into patient education and support strategies.
items.limitation: 这项定性研究基于 YouTube 评论，其代表性和深度可能有限，无法完全反映所有患者的观点。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study, based on YouTube comments, may have limited representativeness and depth, not fully reflecting all patient perspectives.

items.title: Discussing pain increases at the point of exercise prescription: a clinical commentary for persistent musculoskeletal conditions.
items.summary: A clinical commentary suggests that clinicians should discuss potential pain increases at the point of exercise prescription for persistent musculoskeletal conditions, rather than after symptoms occur, to improve patient preparation and adherence, as no universal adjustment rule exists.
items.curatedReason: 这篇临床评论提醒你，在为慢性肌肉骨骼疼痛患者开具运动处方时，务必提前讨论症状可能加重的问题。由于目前尚无统一的疼痛管理规则，与患者建立共识性沟通比提供通用算法更重要，这能提高患者依从性并促使他们及时寻求建议。
items.titleZh: 在运动处方阶段讨论疼痛增加：针对持续性肌肉骨骼疾病的临床评论
items.summaryZh: 一篇临床评论建议，对于持续性肌肉骨骼疾病，临床医生应在开具运动处方时讨论潜在的疼痛增加，而非症状发生之后，以改善患者的准备和依从性，因为目前尚无通用的调整规则。
items.curatedReasonEn: This clinical commentary highlights the crucial need to proactively discuss potential symptom aggravation when prescribing exercise for chronic musculoskeletal pain. Given the lack of a universal pain management rule, establishing a consensual dialogue with patients is more vital than providing generic algorithms, which can improve adherence and timely help-seeking.

items.title: Criterion validity of the Watt-max Test and Test Assessors' judgement of V..O2max achievement in Individuals with Heart Disease
items.summary: This study examined the criterion validity of the Watt-max Test and assessors' judgment for V̇O2max achievement in individuals with heart disease, supporting its use in cardiac rehabilitation for assessing aerobic capacity.
items.curatedReason: 如果你正在为心脏病患者评估最大摄氧量（V̇O2max），可以考虑使用Watt-max测试和评估者的判断。这项观察研究支持了它们的效度，为心脏康复中的有氧能力评估提供了一个更可靠的工具。
items.titleZh: Watt-max测试和评估者对心血管疾病患者V̇O2max达成判断的效标效度
items.summaryZh: 本研究评估了Watt-max测试和评估者对心血管疾病患者最大摄氧量（V̇O2max）达成判断的效标效度，支持其在心脏康复中评估有氧能力的应用。
items.curatedReasonEn: If you're assessing V̇O2max in individuals with heart disease, consider incorporating the Watt-max Test and assessor judgment. This observational study supports their criterion validity, offering a more reliable tool for aerobic capacity assessment in cardiac rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 研究对象仅限于心血管疾病患者，结果对外推至其他人群可能有限。
items.limitationEn: The study population was limited to individuals with heart disease, which may limit generalizability to other populations.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Calibrating clinical reasoning under uncertainty: a qualitative study of expert physiotherapists in musculoskeletal practice.
items.summary: A qualitative study explored how ten expert physiotherapists calibrate clinical reasoning under uncertainty using 24 short musculoskeletal clinical vignettes, revealing they use clinical scripts flexibly, assign decisional weight to various cues, and transform uncertainty into action through provisional decisions, monitoring, and adjustment.
items.curatedReason: 这项针对 10 名专家物理治疗师的质性研究提示，面对不确定性，灵活运用临床脚本、权衡各项线索并进行试探性决策和调整，是处理复杂病例的关键。这有助于我们反思自己的临床决策流程。
items.titleZh: 不确定性下临床推理的校准：一项针对肌肉骨骼领域专家物理治疗师的定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究通过 24 个肌肉骨骼临床情景，探讨了 10 位专家物理治疗师在不确定性下如何校准临床推理，发现他们灵活运用临床脚本、根据不同线索分配决策权重，并通过临时决策、监测和调整将不确定性转化为行动。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study of 10 expert physiotherapists suggests that flexibly using clinical scripts, weighing various cues, and making provisional decisions with monitoring and adjustment are key to managing complex cases under uncertainty. This helps us reflect on our own clinical decision-making processes.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量小且基于书面情景模拟，可能无法完全捕捉真实临床互动的复杂性。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study uses a small sample and relies on written clinical vignettes, which may not fully capture the complexity of real-world clinical interactions.

items.title: Point-of-Care Computer Vision for Postural Assessment in Brain Injury Rehabilitation.
items.summary: A clinician-led, computer vision (CV)-based system for point-of-care postural assessment in people with acquired brain injury (n=20) showed excellent usability (System Usability Scale: 85.3 ± 12.3) and captured therapy-related improvements in seated cervical lateral flexion (-0.084°/day) and standing trunk lateral flexion (-0.096°/day).
items.curatedReason: 这款计算机视觉（CV）工具为获得性脑损伤患者的姿势评估提供了客观、可行的方案，并能捕捉到康复治疗带来的姿势变化。这提示你未来在神经康复领域，利用 AI 工具进行实时、量化评估，将可能成为常规辅助手段。
items.titleZh: 点对点计算机视觉在脑损伤康复中姿势评估的应用
items.summaryZh: 一项由临床医生主导、基于计算机视觉的系统，用于获得性脑损伤（ABI）患者（n=20）的即时姿势评估，显示出极佳的可用性（系统可用性量表：85.3 ± 12.3），并能捕捉到治疗后坐姿颈椎侧屈（每日减少 0.084°）和站姿躯干侧屈（每日减少 0.096°）的改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: This computer vision (CV) tool offers an objective and feasible solution for postural assessment in individuals with acquired brain injury, capable of capturing therapy-related postural changes. This suggests that in neurorehabilitation, AI tools for real-time, quantitative assessment may become a standard auxiliary method in the future.
items.limitation: 这项初步评估是小样本观察性研究，尚需大规模验证其在不同临床情境下的外推性。
items.limitationEn: This preliminary evaluation is a small-sample observational study, requiring large-scale validation for generalizability across diverse clinical settings.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation
